item.title: Water hyacinth watch
item.description: Victorians are urged to keep an eye out for water hyacinth after an infestation on a rural property in Anakie, north of Geelong. Water hyacinth (eichhornia crassipes) is a state-prohibited weed declared under the Catchment and Land Protection Act 1994.
